manifest.name: dsh-codebuddy-auth
manifest.description: DEPRECATED, unmaintained — use shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy or corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect. Was: CodeBuddy (Tencent IOA) as a native DeepSeek Harness llm provider: browser OAuth login, token auto-renewal, credential storage, and /v3/config model sync.

bundle.text:
# The dsh-codebuddy-auth bundle patch: inserts this plugin over any
# composition that already provides the `tools`, `settings`, and
# `credentials` services (the dsh base and web profiles both do). Config
# keys omitted here keep their schema defaults.

- insert:
    - id: codebuddy-auth
      name: dsh-codebuddy-auth

readme.text:
English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> [!WARNING]
> **DEPRECATED — this project is no longer maintained. The repository is archived.**
> Use the upstream projects directly instead:
> - [shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy](https://github.com/shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy) — Tencent CodeBuddy plugin for DeepSeek Harness
> - [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) — bring WorkBuddy desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration

Use [Tencent CodeBuddy](https://www.codebuddy.cn) (IOA) chat models directly in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): browser OAuth login, automatic token renewal, and model-list sync. Log in once, and craft-agent models such as `deepseek-v4-pro`, `glm-5.2`, `kimi-k3-1`, and `minimax-m3` appear in the model picker.

The plugin registers a **native `ctx.llm` adapter** on the `codebuddy` provider and owns the whole request path: browser OAuth, token storage in `ctx.credentials`, model discovery from `/v3/config`, and its own SSE streaming + message serialization. Two deliberate identities, one per plane:

| Plane | Identity | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chat (`POST /v2/chat/completions`) | CLI client (`User-Agent: CLI/2.96.0 CodeBuddy/2.96.0`, minimal headers) | The CLI identity is what the chat endpoint expects; using it avoids IDE-identity blocks. |
| Model discovery (`GET /v3/config`) | Craft / VSCode (`X-Agent-Intent: craft`, `X-IDE-*`) | The craft catalog is the only one disclosing per-model reasoning metadata (`supportedEfforts`, `canDisableThinking`, `defaultEffort`) and the curated model list. The CLI catalog answers the same endpoint but carries only fixed `effort` values. |
The catalog is cached for 5 minutes and refreshed on demand (`sync-models`).

Verified against the DeepSeek Harness desktop app **0.2.0-rc.2** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 0.2.0-rc.2). The adapter follows the current harness contract: tool-call ids are branded via `ToolCallId` (`CallId` no longer exists), and tool results replay as standalone `role: 'tool'` messages. Version 0.8.2 and older serialized tool results as plain user text, so any tool-using conversation failed with `CodeBuddy API error (HTTP 400)` (`11148 tool calls and tool results do not match`) on its second turn.

DSH installs profile plugins through its official `dsh plugin` CLI (a thin `pnpm` forwarder: installs the dependency, appends the package to the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` layer stack, and mounts the plugin via the bundle's in-package patch — no manual file editing).

**Prerequisite**: make sure `pnpm` is on your `PATH`, e.g. via Homebrew:

```bash
brew install pnpm
```

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:cainiao1992/dsh-codebuddy-auth
```

This single command resolves the dependency from GitHub, installs it, and activates the plugin as a profile layer.
Restart DSH. The plugin registers the `codebuddy` provider natively on `ctx.llm` at startup, so CodeBuddy already appears in the Models page — unauthenticated — before you log in.
You can log in either through the agent, or from the command line. Pick one.

Tell the agent **"log in with codebuddy"**. The agent calls the `codebuddy` tool, which opens the IOA login page in your browser and polls in the background; once the token arrives it writes credentials and warms the catalog, and the next request hits the chat endpoint directly.

readme.section: Option B — from the command line (headless / bootstrapping)
readme.text: ```bash

readme.section: Directly, no npm deps, Node >= 18 only:
readme.text: node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-codebuddy-auth/bin/login-flow.mjs

readme.section: Or via the package bin from the install directory:
readme.text: cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm exec codebuddy-login

readme.section: Add --no-browser on a remote server / headless box
readme.text:
```

The CLI only writes the credentials — the native adapter owns the route, so there is no settings route to manage; `--international` merely selects the OAuth endpoints the login itself uses.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-codebuddy-auth
```

This removes the dependency and takes the plugin back out of the profile layer stack. Restart DSH to unload it.

The plugin targets the **China edition** by default (`copilot.tencent.com` / `www.codebuddy.cn`). Select the **international edition** (`www.codebuddy.ai`) through the mount row's `edition: intl` config:

```yaml

- id: codebuddy-auth
  name: dsh-codebuddy-auth
  edition: intl          # omitted = China edition
```

The adapter and the login/model-discovery endpoints then all use `www.codebuddy.ai`. The CLI's `--international` only selects the international OAuth endpoints for the login itself.

- **Switch models**: pick any model under CodeBuddy in the model picker (e.g. `deepseek-v4-pro`)
- **Status**: "check codebuddy status" → the `codebuddy` tool's `status` action
- **Renewal (automatic, three layers)**: ① at every startup, the token is renewed when less than 5 minutes of validity remains (or it has already expired); ② while running, a check every 30 minutes renews whenever less than 1 hour remains — covering a long-lived dsh that never restarts; ③ if the refresh token itself is invalidated (password change / revocation), the first two layers fail and log it — then say "refresh codebuddy" to confirm, or log in again
- **Model updates**: after Tencent ships new models, say "sync codebuddy models" → `sync-models`
- **Logout**: "log out of codebuddy" → clears stored credentials
Each model is declared with its **full real reasoning capability** from `/v3/config`, so the model picker shows the levels each model actually offers:

- **Selectable levels** (per model): `supportedEfforts` mirrors straight into the picker — `deepseek-v4-pro` offers `low` / `high` / `xhigh`, `hy3` offers `low` / `high`, fixed-effort models (e.g. `glm-5.1`) offer their single `medium`. Sent on the wire as `reasoning_effort: "<level>"`.
- **Default level**: each model uses the `defaultEffort` its `/v3/config` entry reports (e.g. `glm-5.2` defaults to `high`); every declared level stays selectable in the picker.

- `lib/index.js` — the Cordis host plugin (host composition row). Registers the `codebuddy` provider and the `codebuddy` tool; refreshes/syncs at startup and every 30 minutes.
- `lib/codebuddy-adapter.mjs` — the native `ctx.llm` adapter: SSE streaming, message serialization, reasoning metadata, error mapping. Ported from [shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy](https://github.com/shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy) (MIT).
- `lib/codebuddy-core.mjs` — OAuth, JWT decoding, identity headers, and `/v3/config` discovery; dependency-free.
- `bin/login-flow.mjs` — standalone login CLI; no npm dependencies.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — in-package patch (self-mount row for bundle consumers).

**Plugin manager shows `failed to import` / the `codebuddy` tool never appears.** The desktop app reports only the summary; boot a copy of the profile to see the real import error:

```bash
cp -R ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop ~/.dsh/profiles/cbprobe
dsh --profile cbprobe --no-open   # the failed entry and its cause print on stderr
rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/cbprobe
```

Verified causes:

- **dsh renamed a dsh-llm export the plugin imports.** dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 renamed `CallId` to `ToolCallId`; plugin ≤0.8.2 fails ESM linking (`does not provide an export named 'CallId'`) and its entry stays inactive. Fixed in 0.8.3 — upgrade below.
- **A stale profile-level symlink** (left by an older manual setup) occupying `@deepseek-ai/*` inside `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules`. Check and remove such links; DSH itself routes installation-scope packages into the desktop `app.asar` copy, so no asar extraction or manual symlinks are needed.

Upgrade (desktop: fully quit the app first — its profile is Electron-managed):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop update dsh-codebuddy-auth   # desktop, after quitting the app
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-codebuddy-auth       # other profiles, any time
```

A git dependency stays pinned by `pnpm-lock.yaml`: `pnpm install` and a repeated `dsh plugin add` reuse the pinned commit. `dsh plugin update <pkg>` is what re-resolves `github:<owner>/<repo>` to a new HEAD.

Do not verify resolution with a bare `node --input-type=module -e "import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm')"` — it bypasses DSH's module-resolution interception and always fails from a profile directory. The probe-profile boot above is the real signal.

- `POST /v2/chat/completions` **does not check User-Agent** — any UA works; but the request must be `stream: true` (non-streaming returns `code 11101`). DSH's llm adapters are streaming by default, so nothing to handle.
- `GET /v3/config` (model discovery) requires the craft / VSCode identity (`X-Agent-Intent: craft` + `X-IDE-*` headers) to disclose reasoning metadata; the plugin sends its own direct request for that.
- CodeBuddy reports `supportsReasoning` on every craft model. Models are declared with their real reasoning capability (levels per `supportedEfforts`), so reasoning is selectable in the model picker rather than stripped.
MIT

[English](README.md) | 简体中文

> [!WARNING]
> **本项目已弃用,不再维护,仓库已存档。**
> 请直接使用上游项目:
> - [shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy](https://github.com/shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy) — DeepSeek Harness 的腾讯 CodeBuddy 插件
> - [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) — 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 内置模型零配置接入 DeepSeek Harness

在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)(DSH) 里直接使用[腾讯 CodeBuddy](https://www.codebuddy.cn)(IOA)的对话模型:浏览器 OAuth 登录、token 自动续期、模型列表自动同步。登录一次,模型选择器里即可选用 `deepseek-v4-pro`、`glm-5.2`、`kimi-k3-1`、`minimax-m3` 等 craft agent 模型。
插件在 `codebuddy` provider 上注册**原生 `ctx.llm` 适配器**,自己持有整条请求链路:浏览器 OAuth、`ctx.credentials` 凭据存储、`/v3/config` 模型发现、自有的 SSE 流式与消息序列化。两套身份,按平面各司其职:

| 平面 | 身份 | 原因 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 聊天(`POST /v2/chat/completions`) | CLI 客户端(`User-Agent: CLI/2.96.0 CodeBuddy/2.96.0`,极简请求头) | 聊天端点期待 CLI 身份,用它可避开 IDE 身份拦截。 |
| 模型发现(`GET /v3/config`) | Craft / VSCode(`X-Agent-Intent: craft` + `X-IDE-*`) | craft 目录是唯一披露每模型推理元数据(`supportedEfforts`、`canDisableThinking`、`defaultEffort`)与精选模型列表的目录;CLI 目录同一端点只返回固定的 `effort` 值。 |

模型目录缓存 5 分钟,可随时 `sync-models` 刷新。

已在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 **0.2.0-rc.2**(`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 0.2.0-rc.2)上验证。适配器遵循当前宿主契约:tool-call id 经 `ToolCallId` 品牌化(`CallId` 已不存在),工具结果以独立 `role: 'tool'` 消息回放。0.8.2 及更早版本把工具结果序列化成普通 user 文本,任何用到工具的对话都会在第二轮报 `CodeBuddy API error (HTTP 400)`(`11148 tool calls and tool results do not match`)。

DSH 通过官方 `dsh plugin` CLI 安装 profile 插件(它是个精简的 `pnpm` 转发器:安装依赖、把包追加到 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 层栈、再经包内的 patch 挂载插件——全程无需手动改文件)。

**前置条件**:确保 `pnpm` 在 `PATH` 里,例如用 Homebrew 安装:

```bash
brew install pnpm
```

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:cainiao1992/dsh-codebuddy-auth
```

这一条命令即从 GitHub 解析依赖、安装,并自动把插件作为 profile 层激活。
重启 DSH,安装即完成——插件启动时在 `ctx.llm` 上原生注册 `codebuddy` provider,CodeBuddy 随即出现在模型页(未登录状态)。
可以用 agent 登录,也可以用命令行登录,二选一。
对 agent 说 **"用 codebuddy 登录"**。agent 调用 `codebuddy` 工具:浏览器打开 IOA 登录页,后台轮询;token 到手后写入凭据并预热模型目录,下一个请求即以 CLI 身份直连聊天端点。

readme.section: 方式二:命令行(headless / 提前引导)
readme.text: ```bash

readme.section: 直接运行,无 npm 依赖,仅需 Node >= 18:
readme.text: node ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-codebuddy-auth/bin/login-flow.mjs

readme.section: 或经 package.json 的 bin 字段从安装目录本地解析:
readme.text: cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm exec codebuddy-login

readme.section: 不想开浏览器(远程/服务器)加 --no-browser
readme.text:
```

CLI 只写凭据——原生适配器自己持有路由,没有 settings 路由需要管理;`--international` 仅选择登录走的 OAuth 端点。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-codebuddy-auth
```

该命令会移除依赖,并把插件从 profile 层栈中摘除。重启 DSH 即完成卸载。

插件默认使用**国内版**(`copilot.tencent.com` / `www.codebuddy.cn`)。国际版(`www.codebuddy.ai`)通过挂载行的 `edition: intl` 配置选择:

```yaml

- id: codebuddy-auth
  name: dsh-codebuddy-auth
  edition: intl          # 缺省即国内版
```

适配器与登录/模型发现随即全部使用 `www.codebuddy.ai` 端点。CLI 的 `--international` 仅为登录选择国际 OAuth 端点。

- **切换模型**:模型选择器里选 CodeBuddy 下的任意模型(如 `deepseek-v4-pro`)
- **状态**:"看下 codebuddy 状态" → `codebuddy` 工具 `status`
- **续期(全自动,三层)**:① 每次启动时,token 剩余有效期不足 5 分钟(或已过期)即自动续;② 运行中每 30 分钟巡检,剩余不足 1 小时自动续——覆盖 dsh 长期不重启的场景;③ refresh token 失效(改密/吊销)时前两层会失败并留日志,此时说 "刷新 codebuddy" 确认,或重新登录
- **模型更新**:腾讯上新模型后,说 "同步 codebuddy 模型" → `sync-models`
- **退出**:"登出 codebuddy" → 清除凭据

每个模型都按 `/v3/config` 报告的**完整真实推理能力**声明,模型选择器里展示该模型实际支持的等级:

- **可选等级**(按模型):`supportedEfforts` 原样进选择器——`deepseek-v4-pro` 可选 `low` / `high` / `xhigh`,`hy3` 可选 `low` / `high`,固定等级模型(如 `glm-5.1`)只有 `medium` 一档。线上以 `reasoning_effort: "<level>"` 发送。
- **默认等级**:每模型直接采用 `/v3/config` 报告的 `defaultEffort`(如 glm-5.2 默认 high),选择器里所有已声明等级仍可自由选。

- `lib/index.js` — Cordis 宿主插件(host 组合行)。注册 `codebuddy` provider 与 `codebuddy` 工具,启动时及每 30 分钟自动刷新/同步。
- `lib/codebuddy-adapter.mjs` — 原生 `ctx.llm` 适配器:SSE 流式、消息序列化、推理元数据、错误映射。移植自 [shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy](https://github.com/shatyuka/dsh-llm-codebuddy)(MIT)。
- `lib/codebuddy-core.mjs` — OAuth、JWT 解码、身份头、`/v3/config` 发现;无依赖。
- `bin/login-flow.mjs` — 独立登录 CLI,无 npm 依赖。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — 包内 patch(bundle 消费时的自挂载行)。

**插件管理器显示 `failed to import` / `codebuddy` 工具始终不出现。** 桌面端只给一句摘要;复制一份 profile 冷启动,就能看到真正的导入错误:

```bash
cp -R ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop ~/.dsh/profiles/cbprobe
dsh --profile cbprobe --no-open   # 失败的 entry 及其原因会打到 stderr
rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/cbprobe
```

实测过的两种原因:

- **dsh 改名了插件用到的 dsh-llm 导出。** dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 把 `CallId` 改名为 `ToolCallId`,插件 ≤0.8.2 在 ESM 链接阶段就失败(`does not provide an export named 'CallId'`),entry 保持未激活。0.8.3 已修复,按下述命令升级即可。
- **profile 里残留的软链接**(早期手动安装遗留)占住了 `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules` 里的 `@deepseek-ai/*` 名字。检查并删除这类死链即可;DSH 自身会把 installation 作用域的包路由进桌面版 `app.asar` 副本,不需要抽取 asar、也不需要手动软链。

升级(桌面版:先完全退出应用——该 profile 由 Electron 独占管理):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop update dsh-codebuddy-auth   # 桌面版,退出应用后执行
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-codebuddy-auth       # 其他 profile 随时可执行
```

git 依赖会被 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 钉住:`pnpm install` 和重复的 `dsh plugin add` 都复用已锁定的 commit;`dsh plugin update <pkg>`(即 pnpm update)才会把 `github:<owner>/<repo>` 重新解析到新 HEAD。

不要用裸 `node --input-type=module -e "import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm')"` 验证解析——它绕过了 DSH 的模块解析拦截,在 profile 目录里必然失败。上面探针 profile 的冷启动输出才是有效信号。

readme.section: 已知限制(均为实测结论)
readme.text:
- `POST /v2/chat/completions` **不校验 User-Agent**,任意 UA 均可;但必须 `stream: true`(非流式返回 `code 11101`)。DSH 的 llm 适配器本来就是流式,无需处理。
- `GET /v3/config`(模型发现)需要 craft / VSCode 身份(`X-Agent-Intent: craft` + `X-IDE-*` 头)才会披露推理元数据;插件自己直接发请求完成。
- CodeBuddy 对每个 craft 模型都报告 `supportsReasoning`。模型按真实推理能力声明(按 `supportedEfforts` 列出等级),因此推理可在模型选择器里直接选用,而非被剥离。
